# Top 10 Best Cordless Vacuums (Lightweight) in 2026

Cordless vacuums have evolved from toy-like gadgets to serious cleaning tools. The best models rival corded vacuums in suction power while weighing under 7 pounds. After extensive testing, here are the best lightweight cordless vacuums for 2026.

## Our Top Picks in Detail

### 1. Dyson V8 Animal - Best Overall Lightweight Vacuum

The Dyson V8 Animal remains the best all-around cordless vacuum. At 5.75 pounds, it is light enough for stairs and overhead cleaning. The 40-minute battery life covers average homes, and the direct-drive brush head removes pet hair from carpets with ease. The hygienic dust ejector empties the bin without touching dirt. At $349.99, it is a proven performer.

**Price:** $349.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 2. Shark Stratos - Best Feature-Rich

The Shark Stratos stands out with CleanSense IQ technology that automatically adjusts suction based on debris detection. The DualFlyte technology provides separate air channels for gentle floor cleaning and powerful carpet suction. At $299.99, it is one of the most feature-rich options available.

**Price:** $299.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 3. Dyson V12 Detect Slim - Lightest Premium Option

At just 5.0 pounds, the Dyson V12 Detect Slim is the lightest premium cordless vacuum. The laser-optic flashlight reveals microscopic dust on hard floors. At $549.99, it is expensive but the innovation justifies the price for those who prioritize ergonomics.

**Price:** $549.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 4. Samsung Jet 75 - Best Suction Power

The Samsung Jet 75 boasts an impressive 200 AW of suction - the highest on this list. At 5.3 pounds, it is one of the lightest options. At $279.99, it offers exceptional value for the power it delivers.

**Price:** $279.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 5. Eureka Groove - Best Budget Pick

The Eureka Groove is the lightest vacuum at just 4.0 pounds, making it ideal for seniors. At $69.99, it is the most affordable option that still delivers decent cleaning performance. For apartments and small homes, it excels.

**Price:** $69.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How long do cordless vacuum batteries last?**
A: Most lithium-ion batteries last 3-5 years or 300-500 charge cycles.

**Q: Can cordless vacuums clean carpets?**
A: Yes. Modern cordless vacuums with 100+ AW suction clean carpets effectively.

---

## Final Verdict

For most homes, the **Dyson V8 Animal at $349.99** is the best balance. If you want the lightest option, the **Dyson V12 Detect at $549.99** is worth the premium. And for budget buyers, the **Eureka Groove at $69.99** proves you do not need to spend much.
